column1: ## Hand status per witness, for the author-by-scribe design.
## A witness may be the work of several scribes, so two passages of one
## manuscript are in one hand only where that is documented. The converse is
## definitive: another witness is always another hand.
## status: one_hand | multi_hand | unknown
## Nothing here is written from memory. Every non-Ambraser row carries the
## Handschriftencensus id it was read from and the statement quoted verbatim;
## `unknown` means the page says nothing about the number of hands, which is the
## common case.
## FINDING OF THE 2026-09-26 SAMPLE: of six witnesses looked up, four say nothing
## and two document several hands. NONE was documented as single-hand. The
## database therefore disqualifies witnesses; it does not certify them, so the
## same-scribe row of the design cannot be built from same-witness pairs.
## Columns: witness  source  siglum  shelfmark  status  hands  hsc  evidence
